concerns.text: FR-001 and SC-007 require ingestion metrics (rows_ingested, null_handling_success_rate) and validation logs. Task T010 is marked incomplete and is the ONLY task generating `artifacts/reports/ingestion_metrics.json` and `validation_log.json`. Without T010, SC-007 cannot be measured.

FR-007 mandates outlier clipping at the 99th percentile BEFORE statistical tests. Task T018 (implement outlier clipping) is marked incomplete. No other task performs this specific clipping logic, leaving the pipeline unable to satisfy FR-007 or SC-006 (MAE check on cleaned data).

FR-002 requires engineering interaction features (`cold_work * Mn_content`, etc.) and including `annealing_temp_K` as a standalone feature. Task T019 is marked incomplete. No other task performs this feature engineering, blocking US1 completion and downstream US2/US3.

FR-003, FR-004, and SC-001/SC-006 require a trained Random Forest model, 5-fold CV, and MAE/R² reporting. Tasks T024 (training), T026 (test eval), T027 (save model), and T028 (metrics report) are all marked incomplete. No artifacts (`kinetic_model.pkl`, `training_metrics.json`) can be generated.

Edge Cases and FR-008 require detecting 'pure aluminum' (zero variance) and setting `pure_aluminum_flag`. Task T029 is marked incomplete. No other task implements this detection logic, violating the spec's edge case handling.

FR-005 and FR-006 require a Delta-Permutation Test and SHAP Interaction analysis. Tasks T032 (Additive Model), T034 (Permutation Test), T036 (SHAP), T037 (Significance Report), and T038 (SHAP Report) are all marked incomplete. The core research validation (US3) is unimplemented.

FR-001 and Constitution Principle I require a deterministic synthetic generator (seed=42) as the primary source. Task T006 (generate synthetic data) is marked incomplete. Without this, the pipeline has no primary data source, blocking all subsequent US1 tasks.
SC-006 requires comparing MAE against the `baseline_mean` of the synthetic data. Task T007 (calculate baseline stats) is marked incomplete. Without `baseline_stats.json`, SC-006 cannot be evaluated.

Plan.md and Constitution Principle V require directory structure and `.gitkeep` files for data hygiene. Tasks T001, T002, and T003 are marked incomplete. The foundational file system required for data artifacts does not exist.

FR-005 requires a Permutation Test shuffling interaction terms. Task T034 is incomplete. Task T033 (ensure Interaction Model consistency) is marked `[~]` (in-progress/unclear) and relies on T027 (incomplete). The statistical validation logic is missing.
Plan.md requires `quickstart.md` validation. Task T050 (Run quickstart validation) is marked incomplete. Without this, the end-to-end execution of the full pipeline (US1+US2+US3) is not verified.

Phase 6 tasks (T051-T059) are review tasks dependent on the implementation of T018, T029, T034, etc. Since the underlying implementation tasks are incomplete, these review tasks cannot be executed, creating a blockage in the analysis phase.
